dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit soft-edged gradients transitioning from dark charcoal exterior perimeters to light grey interiors. The most prominent 'O' shape on the upper mid-back shows a non-uniform, slightly elongated perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of irregular, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral flank and the ventral neck region. These clusters lack internal gradient structures and appear as localized, asymmetrical concentrations of lighter pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of the largest dorsal annulus, the secondary annulus located posterior to the flipper, and a prominent 'C' shaped structure on the mid-dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, dark parallel segments corresponding to claw structures are visible on the pectoral flipper, contrasting against the lighter grey texture of the limb surface.
